# Jose Peláez

> Product and brand designer based in Madrid. Brand identities, websites and digital products, designed and built end to end.

Brand identity, product design and the front-end build that ships it. Day to day, product interfaces at Seedtag; alongside that, brand and product work taken on directly, from naming and identity to websites.

Services: brand identity & naming, product & UI design, web design & development, design systems.

Contact: josepelaez0218@gmail.com

## Pages

- [Home](/): Selected projects and a short introduction.
- [Seedtag Design System](/work/seedtag-design-system): A design system built for Seedtag's internal tools — shared components, patterns and tone applied across every internal web app, including Liz Agent.
- [Mosaic](/work/mosaic): A creative-diagnosis tool for Seedtag's neuro-contextual AI — turning dense attention and emotion data into pre-campaign recommendations a creative team can act on. (Campaign examples shown throughout are fictional, built for demonstration only.)
- [Emotion Quotient](/work/seedtag-emotion-quotient): A live weekly report ranking the 5 cultural moments the world felt most — built on Seedtag's own content-emotion technology.
- [Black Coffee](/work/black-coffee): Brand identity for a coffee brand: a stacked wordmark of rounded, stencil-like letters, built to be cropped, enlarged and applied to cards, packaging, posters and signage.
- [500 Años de Historia](/work/500-anos-de-historia): Brand identity for an art exhibition.
